notes: Table.sas defines %combine_contributions, a %do-loop macro that originally imported six yearly Wyoming FEC contribution CSVs via PROC IMPORT, appended contribution_receipt_amount/report_year, then joined the yearly totals against mean-income and poverty-status CSV extracts (PROC TRANSPOSE + PROC SQL join + PROC SORT). All eight external CSV files are replaced with fabricated inline DATALINES of the same shape (7 synthetic contribution amounts per year x 6 years, one income row, one poverty row) so the macro loop and the join/transpose/sort logic run unmodified. Added a trailing PROC PRINT (not in the original) to surface the joined result as bundle output. No real FEC records are included.
